watch.summary: The creator barely saves his egg character from a catastrophic fall and immediately turns around to scold chat for giving him horrible advice.

beats.what: The egg tumbles downward as the streamer yells in panic.
The egg unexpectedly catches itself on a lower plank, narrowly avoiding resetting progress.
The creator shifts into deadpan scolding, targeting the chat member who suggested the route.
He tells chat to 'use your brain' while pretending he wants to be respectful and not call names.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The comedic shift from frantic screaming during a near-disaster to a calm, passive-aggressive lecture against his own viewers lands well. However, the stakes rely heavily on physics game tension which isn't universally funny.
